#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Servo.h>

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Servo.h>

Servo myServo;
Servo myServo2;

const int inputPin = 0;
const int outputPin = 3;
const int outputPin2 = 2;


int pos = 0;   
void  setup() {
  myServo.attach(outputPin);  // attaches the servo on pin 9 to the servo object
  myServo2.attach(outputPin2);
  Serial.begin(115200);
  myServo.write(180);
  myServo2.write(0);
}

void loop() {
  char myControllerChar = '';
  servoAngle = 0;

    myControllerChar = Serial.read();
    if (myControllerChar == 'a') {
      
      servoAngle += 1;
    }
    else if (myControllerChar == 'd') {
      myServo.write(servoAngle);
      myServo2.write(180 - servoAngle);
      servoAngle -= 1;
    }
    else if (myControllerChar == '')
      Serial.println("Please enter (a or d): ");
    else {
      Serial.println("Please enter a valid input (a or d): ");
    }
  }
